title: barkhausia taraxacifolia subsp. heterocarpa
intro: Barkhausia taraxacifolia subsp. heterocarpa, commonly known as B. heterocarpa, is a plant species within the family Guttiferae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of B. heterocarpa are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit analgesic and antipyretic effects, and serve as a natural remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of B. heterocarpa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
